description: Defines the IFrameRate interface and its nested INotification interface for managing and receiving events related to frame rate display and measurement in the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IFrameRate
classes.description: Interface for managing frame rate display and collection, including event notifications and control methods.

classes.name: IFrameRate::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving frame rate related events such as FPS updates and display rate changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for frame rate events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves the current display frame rate and success status.

methods.name: GetFrmMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto frame rate mode and success status.

methods.name: SetCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the interval for FPS data collection.

methods.name: SetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the display frame rate value.

methods.name: SetFrmMode
methods.description: Sets the auto frame rate mode.
